ayat.text: أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ
الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ
لِكَيْلاَ تَأْسَوْا عَلَى مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَفْرَحُوا بِمَا آتَاكُمْ

dua.text: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري واحلل عقدة من لساني يفقهوا قولي
إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا

topics.name: The Distressed Supplicant (Al-Mudhtarr)
topics.description: Definition of Al-Mudhtarr (the distressed) and how sincere du'a in extreme hardship invokes divine relief.

topics.name: Trials as Means of Purification and Sincerity
topics.description: Understanding why Allah tests believers with hardships to strip away reliance on others and foster pure sincerity (ikhlas).

topics.name: Blessings and Expiation of Sins in Illness
topics.description: How physical and mental sufferings, even a prick of a thorn or fever, serve as expiation for sins and elevate ranks.

topics.name: Patience and the Sunnah Du'a upon Calamity
topics.description: The etiquettes of reacting to calamities with 'Inna Lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un' and seeking a better substitute from Allah.

topics.name: Acceptance of Divine Decree and Contentment (Rida)
topics.description: Embracing trials with absolute trust, avoiding despair, and recognizing tests as part of the earthly trial (Dar al-Imtihan).
